title: Eye of Inner Worlds
description: A surreal painting of a large cracked white eye with a red fleshy outline set against a starry cosmic background. Inside the pupil is a green landscape with an open doorway revealing a gray face with a third eye, while below the eye silhouetted human figures dance among vibrant glowing flowers connected by red and purple vines.
prompt: surreal visionary artwork of a giant cracked white eye with red organic edges floating in a starry galaxy. The iris contains an open green doorway revealing a monolithic gray face with a third eye on its forehead. Below the eye, glowing silhouetted human figures dance and hold green orbs among oversized purple, red and blue flowers connected by flowing red and purple vines, cosmic space background with nebulae and spiral galaxies, vibrant psychedelic style
